bio.en: Full-stack developer and AI integration specialist. Has configured and tested API integrations with 20+ AI model providers including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, DeepSeek, and more. Every guide on this site is based on hands-on testing with real API keys.
bio.zh: 全栈开发者，AI 集成方向。已实际配置并测试过 20+ AI 模型供应商的 API 集成，包括 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google、DeepSeek 等。本站每篇指南都基于真实 API Key 的亲手测试。

experience.en: 8+ years building web applications, 3+ years integrating LLM APIs in production
experience.zh: 8 年以上 Web 应用开发经验，3 年以上生产环境 LLM API 集成经验

editorialProcess.en: Every guide follows a hands-on testing protocol: we register a real account, generate an actual API key, write and run test code, and document the entire process. We re-verify all information at least once per quarter and update guides when providers change their APIs, pricing, or dashboards.
editorialProcess.zh: 每篇指南都遵循实测流程：注册真实账号、生成实际 API Key、编写并运行测试代码、记录全过程。我们至少每季度重新验证一次所有信息，并在供应商更改 API、定价或控制台时更新指南。
